(2) 将被积函数做幂级数展开, 再逐项积分.

解（1）记 $F(x) = f(x) + f(1 - x) + \ln x\ln (1 - x)$ ，则

$$
\begin{array}{r l} F ^ {\prime} (x) & = f ^ {\prime} (x) - f ^ {\prime} (1 - x) - \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} + \frac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} \\ & = \frac {1}{x} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {x ^ {n}}{n} - \frac {1}{1 - x} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {(1 - x) ^ {n}}{n} - \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} + \frac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} \\ & = - \frac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} + \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} - \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} + \frac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} = 0, \end{array}
$$

故

$F(x) = f(x) + f(1 - x) + \ln x\ln (1 - x)\equiv C$ （ $C$ 为常数）.

又 $f(0) = 0, f(1) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^2} = \frac{\pi^2}{6}, \lim_{x \to 0^+} \ln x \ln (1 - x) = \lim_{x \to 0^+} (-x) \ln x = 0$ ，所以

$$
f (x) + f (1 - x) + \ln x \ln (1 - x) = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{6}.\tag{①}
$$

(2) 将被积函数做幂级数展开, 再逐项积分.

解（1）记 $F(x) = f(x) + f(1 - x) + \ln x\ln (1 - x)$ ，则

$$
\begin{array}{r l} F ^ {\prime} (x) & = f ^ {\prime} (x) - f ^ {\prime} (1 - x) - \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} + \frac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} \\ & = \frac {1}{x} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {x ^ {n}}{n} - \frac {1}{1 - x} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {(1 - x) ^ {n}}{n} - \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} + \frac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} \\ & = - \frac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} + \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} - \frac {\ln x}{1 - x} + \frac {\ln (1 - x)}{x} = 0, \end{array}
$$

故

$F(x) = f(x) + f(1 - x) + \ln x\ln (1 - x)\equiv C$ （ $C$ 为常数）.

又 $f(0) = 0, f(1) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^2} = \frac{\pi^2}{6}, \lim_{x \to 0^+} \ln x \ln (1 - x) = \lim_{x \to 0^+} (-x) \ln x = 0$ ，所以

$$
f (x) + f (1 - x) + \ln x \ln (1 - x) = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{6}.\tag{①}
$$

(2) 方法1 由于

$$
f ^ {\prime} (x) = \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {x ^ {n - 1}}{n} = - \frac {1}{x} \ln (1 - x), f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {x}{2}\right) = - \frac {2}{x} \ln \left(1 - \frac {x}{2}\right) = \frac {2}{x} \ln 2 - \frac {2}{x} \ln (2 - x),
$$

则

$$
I = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{2 - x} \ln \frac {1}{x} d x \stackrel {2 - x = y} {=} - \int_ {1} ^ {2} \frac {1}{y} \ln (2 - y) d y = \int_ {1} ^ {2} \left[ \frac {1}{2} f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {y}{2}\right) - \frac {1}{y} \ln 2 \right] d y = f (1) - \ln^ {2} 2 - f \left(\frac {1}{2}\right).
$$

在①式中取 $x = \frac{1}{2}$ ，得

$$
f \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) + f \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) + \left(\ln \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2} = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{6}, \quad f \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{1 2} - \frac {\ln^ {2} 2}{2},
$$

所以

$$
I = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{2 - x} \ln \frac {1}{x} d x = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{1 2} - \frac {\ln^ {2} 2}{2}.
$$

方法2

$$
\begin{array}{l} I = \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{2 - x} \ln \frac {1}{x} d x \stackrel {2 - x = y} {=} \int_ {2} ^ {1} \frac {1}{y} \ln (2 - y) d y = - \int_ {1} ^ {2} \frac {\ln 2}{y} d y - \int_ {1} ^ {2} \frac {\ln \left(1 - \frac {y}{2}\right)}{y} d y \\ = - \ln^ {2} 2 + \int_ {1} ^ {2} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {y ^ {n - 1}}{2 ^ {n} n} d y = - \ln^ {2} 2 + \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {y ^ {n}}{2 ^ {n} n ^ {2}} \Bigg | _ {1} ^ {2} \\ = - \ln^ {2} 2 + \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} - \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {(1 / 2) ^ {n}}{n ^ {2}} = - \ln^ {2} 2 + f (1) - f \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) = \frac {\pi^ {2}}{1 2} - \frac {\ln^ {2} 2}{2}. \end{array}
$$

评注 问题（2）中的两种解法没有本质上的差异，只是第2种方法更容易理解.
